W.note: Convincing lemon with nub, stem stub, pitted glossy peel and soft shadow, plus clean controls and a sensible phone layout, though the pointed end reads slightly pear-like.

X.note: Nicely textured peel but the shape is a plain egg whose nub only shows at some angles, and on phone the model is cropped and the overlay panel covers it.

Y.note: Pale translucent blob with meridian lines that does not read as a lemon, and it is mostly hidden by the panel on mobile.

Z.note: Strong lemon with nipple, calyx and stem, leaf option, pitted peel and a very thorough control panel, though the pits look a little sparse and flat.
